answers.explanation: Authentication is who you are; authorization is what you may do.
Authentication happens once per login. Authorization happens on every request, for every resource.
Use a slow, salted hash like Argon2, scrypt, or bcrypt.
The work factor is what makes each guess expensive.
The cost is a lookup in a shared session store on every request.
That's why access tokens are short-lived.
The authorization server checks it on each exchange, so revoking it ends access quickly.
